// Synthetic HTTP host for the private P10 conversion. It is generated only into
// an isolated private module; this tracked source contains no Catalyst markup,
// source classes, or paid assets. The generator supplies sourceErrorClass.
package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"compress/gzip"
	"context"
	"crypto/rand"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"crypto/subtle"
	_ "embed"
	"encoding/base64"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"mime"
	"net"
	"net/http"
	"net/url"
	"os"
	"os/signal"
	"path"
	"path/filepath"
	"regexp"
	"sort"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"sync/atomic"
	"syscall"
	"time"
	"unicode/utf8"

	converted "example.test/p10"
)

const (
	expectedReferenceSHA256 = "94d3ab4c145e33bf29af750918429833d833fff3f9ac8820e1314c7f2c67f53d"
	maxPacketFileBytes      = 16 << 20
	maxPOSTBytes            = 64 << 10
	csrfCookieName          = "p10_fixture_csrf"
	cachedStaticV1ID        = "p10-cached-static-v1"
	cachedStaticV2ID        = "p10-cached-static-v2"
	fontAliasManifestID     = "p10-font-query-aliases-v1"
	fontCSSSHA256           = "46d01c7807f64a24c1b2853b756ef15f3a2facdf4a9f066eaf5d39c0c9935441"
	fontCSSBytes            = 11497
	fontURLOccurrences      = 40
	fontAliasCount          = 38
	fontAliasManifestSHA256 = "64bf2d15e55a9faa7793789b891de6e8b227b796ff26dda1c50342cd843e802b"
)

var nativeFieldKeys = []string{
	"name", "bio", "email", "email_is_public", "address", "city",
	"postal_code", "country[code]", "region", "currency",
}

//go:embed controller.mjs
var settingsController []byte

type filePin struct {
	Name   string `json:"name"`
	SHA256 string `json:"sha256"`
	Bytes  int    `json:"bytes"`
}

type packetAsset struct {
	URL  string  `json:"url"`
	MIME string  `json:"mime"`
	File filePin `json:"file"`
}

type referencePacket struct {
	Plan       filePin       `json:"plan"`
	Default    filePin       `json:"default_html"`
	Errors     filePin       `json:"error_html"`
	Countries  filePin       `json:"countries"`
	Defaults   filePin       `json:"defaults"`
	Currencies filePin       `json:"currencies"`
	Assets     []packetAsset `json:"assets"`
	Licenses   []filePin     `json:"licenses"`
	Frames     []struct {
		Screenshot filePin `json:"screenshot"`
	} `json:"frames"`
}

type fixtureAsset struct {
	body []byte
	mime string
}

type cachedFixtureAsset struct {
	body          []byte
	gzipBody      []byte
	mime          string
	decodedSHA256 string
	identityETag  string
	gzipETag      string
}

type fontAliasCSS struct {
	URL    string `json:"url"`
	SHA256 string `json:"sha256"`
	Bytes  int    `json:"bytes"`
}

type fontAliasEntry struct {
	URL          string `json:"url"`
	CanonicalURL string `json:"canonical_url"`
	MIME         string `json:"mime"`
	SHA256       string `json:"sha256"`
	Bytes        int    `json:"bytes"`
}

// fontAliasManifest is deliberately a concrete ordered JSON shape. Its digest
// binds the exact, selected query aliases; it is not a general CSS cache policy.
type fontAliasManifest struct {
	SchemaVersion int              `json:"schema_version"`
	ID            string           `json:"id"`
	CSS           fontAliasCSS     `json:"css"`
	Aliases       []fontAliasEntry `json:"aliases"`
}

type fontAliasDelivery struct {
	assets         map[string]cachedFixtureAsset // exact RequestURI -> prepared canonical representation
	manifestSHA256 string
	manifest       fontAliasManifest
}

type fontAliasContract struct {
	cssSHA256      string
	cssBytes       int
	urlOccurrences int
	aliasCount     int
}

type fixtureConfig struct {
	policy  *converted.SettingsPolicy
	initial converted.SettingsValues
	assets  map[string]fixtureAsset
	cache   map[string]cachedFixtureAsset // nil unless the explicit cached-static mode selected it
	aliases *fontAliasDelivery            // nil unless the explicit v2 mode selected it
	cssURLs []string
	host    string                   // exact loopback host:port selected by the listener
	refuse  func(*http.Request) bool // a test-only synthetic backend refusal seam
}

// prepareCachedStaticAssets runs only after loadFixturePacket has checked the full
// selected private closure, including each asset URL, MIME, byte count, and SHA.
// It keeps no files and creates no cache authority for documents or application data.
func prepareCachedStaticAssets(assets map[string]fixtureAsset) (map[string]cachedFixtureAsset, error) {
	prepared := make(map[string]cachedFixtureAsset, len(assets))
	for assetURL, asset := range assets {
		if !cacheableStaticAssetURL(assetURL) || !allowedAssetMIME(asset.mime) {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("cached static asset refused: %q", assetURL)
		}
		var compressed bytes.Buffer
		writer, err := gzip.NewWriterLevel(&compressed, 6)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("prepare cached static asset %q: %w", assetURL, err)
		}
		if _, err := writer.Write(asset.body); err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("prepare cached static asset %q: %w", assetURL, err)
		}
		if err := writer.Close(); err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("prepare cached static asset %q: %w", assetURL, err)
		}
		gzipBody := compressed.Bytes()
		prepared[assetURL] = cachedFixtureAsset{
			body: asset.body, gzipBody: gzipBody, mime: asset.mime, decodedSHA256: digest(asset.body),
			identityETag: `"` + digest(asset.body) + `"`, gzipETag: `"` + digest(gzipBody) + `"`,
		}
	}
	return prepared, nil
}

var (
	fontAliasCSSURLRE = regexp.MustCompile(`^/[A-Za-z0-9_./-]+/inter\.css$`)
	fontAliasURLRE    = regexp.MustCompile(`^font-files/[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+\.woff2\?v=4\.1$`)
	fontAliasTokenRE  = regexp.MustCompile(`url\(\s*("([^"()\s]+)"|'([^'()\s]+)'|([^'"()\s]+))\s*\)`)
	fontAliasAnyURLRE = regexp.MustCompile(`url\(`)
)

// prepareP10FontQueryAliases retains the one admitted, source-pinned P10
// stylesheet closure. Tests may exercise the parser through the contract helper,
// but production cannot relax this digest, size, or cardinality.
func prepareP10FontQueryAliases(assets map[string]fixtureAsset, prepared map[string]cachedFixtureAsset) (*fontAliasDelivery, error) {
	delivery, err := prepareFontQueryAliases(assets, prepared, fontAliasContract{
		cssSHA256: fontCSSSHA256, cssBytes: fontCSSBytes, urlOccurrences: fontURLOccurrences, aliasCount: fontAliasCount,
	})
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if delivery.manifestSHA256 != fontAliasManifestSHA256 {
		return nil, errors.New("pinned font alias manifest drift")
	}
	return delivery, nil
}

// prepareFontQueryAliases accepts CSS literals only after the caller has loaded
// and SHA-validated the complete private packet. It deliberately has no incoming
// request parsing, URL cleanup, or query normalization authority.
func prepareFontQueryAliases(assets map[string]fixtureAsset, prepared map[string]cachedFixtureAsset, contract fontAliasContract) (*fontAliasDelivery, error) {
	if contract.cssSHA256 == "" || contract.cssBytes < 1 || contract.cssBytes > 64<<10 || contract.urlOccurrences < 1 || contract.aliasCount < 1 {
		return nil, errors.New("invalid font alias contract")
	}
	var cssURL string
	var css fixtureAsset
	for assetURL, asset := range assets {
		if strings.HasSuffix(assetURL, "/inter.css") {
			if cssURL != "" {
				return nil, errors.New("ambiguous font stylesheet")
			}
			cssURL, css = assetURL, asset
		}
	}
	if !fontAliasCSSURLRE.MatchString(cssURL) || css.mime != "text/css" || len(css.body) != contract.cssBytes || digest(css.body) != contract.cssSHA256 || !utf8.Valid(css.body) {
		return nil, errors.New("pinned font stylesheet refused")
	}
	if _, ok := prepared[cssURL]; !ok {
		return nil, errors.New("prepared font stylesheet missing")
	}
	text := string(css.body)
	if !bytes.Equal([]byte(text), css.body) {
		return nil, errors.New("font stylesheet is not exact UTF-8")
	}
	tokens := fontAliasTokenRE.FindAllStringSubmatch(text, -1)
	if len(tokens) != contract.urlOccurrences || len(fontAliasAnyURLRE.FindAllStringIndex(text, -1)) != len(tokens) {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("font stylesheet URL closure refused: %d parsed of %d url occurrences", len(tokens), len(fontAliasAnyURLRE.FindAllStringIndex(text, -1)))
	}
	prefix := strings.TrimSuffix(cssURL, "inter.css")
	aliases := make(map[string]fontAliasEntry, contract.aliasCount)
	canonicalSeen := make(map[string]bool, contract.aliasCount)
	for _, token := range tokens {
		literal := token[2]
		if literal == "" {
			literal = token[3]
		}
		if literal == "" {
			literal = token[4]
		}
		if !fontAliasURLRE.MatchString(literal) {
			return nil, errors.New("font stylesheet URL literal refused")
		}
		canonicalURL := prefix + strings.TrimSuffix(literal, "?v=4.1")
		asset, ok := assets[canonicalURL]
		if !ok || asset.mime != "font/woff2" {
			return nil, errors.New("font stylesheet lacks selected WOFF2 pin")
		}
		cached, ok := prepared[canonicalURL]
		if !ok || cached.mime != asset.mime || !bytes.Equal(cached.body, asset.body) {
			return nil, errors.New("prepared canonical font representation refused")
		}
		aliasURL := prefix + literal
		aliases[aliasURL] = fontAliasEntry{URL: aliasURL, CanonicalURL: canonicalURL, MIME: asset.mime, SHA256: digest(asset.body), Bytes: len(asset.body)}
		canonicalSeen[canonicalURL] = true
	}
	if len(aliases) != contract.aliasCount {
		return nil, errors.New("font alias count refused")
	}
	fonts := 0
	for assetURL, asset := range assets {
		if asset.mime == "font/woff2" {
			fonts++
			if !canonicalSeen[assetURL] {
				return nil, errors.New("selected WOFF2 pin lacks font alias")
			}
		}
	}
	if fonts != contract.aliasCount || len(canonicalSeen) != fonts {
		return nil, errors.New("selected font closure count refused")
	}
	manifest := fontAliasManifest{
		SchemaVersion: 1,
		ID:            fontAliasManifestID,
		CSS:           fontAliasCSS{URL: cssURL, SHA256: contract.cssSHA256, Bytes: len(css.body)},
		Aliases:       make([]fontAliasEntry, 0, len(aliases)),
	}
	for _, alias := range aliases {
		manifest.Aliases = append(manifest.Aliases, alias)
	}
	sort.Slice(manifest.Aliases, func(i, j int) bool { return manifest.Aliases[i].URL < manifest.Aliases[j].URL })
	encoded, err := json.Marshal(manifest)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("marshal font aliases: %w", err)
	}
	delivery := &fontAliasDelivery{assets: make(map[string]cachedFixtureAsset, len(manifest.Aliases)), manifestSHA256: digest(encoded), manifest: manifest}
	for _, alias := range manifest.Aliases {
		delivery.assets[alias.URL] = prepared[alias.CanonicalURL]
	}
	return delivery, nil
}

func loadFixturePacket(packet string) (fixtureConfig, error) {
	if !filepath.IsAbs(packet) || filepath.Clean(packet) != packet {
		return fixtureConfig{}, errors.New("private packet must be an explicit clean absolute path")
	}
	info, err := os.Lstat(packet)
	if err != nil || !info.IsDir() || info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
		return fixtureConfig{}, errors.New("private packet must be an existing non-symlink directory")
	}
	read := func(pin filePin) ([]byte, error) {
		if filepath.Base(pin.Name) != pin.Name || !validPin(pin) {
			return nil, errors.New("invalid private packet file pin")
		}
		file := filepath.Join(packet, pin.Name)
		st, err := os.Lstat(file)
		if err != nil || !st.Mode().IsRegular() || st.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 || st.Size() != int64(pin.Bytes) || st.Size() > maxPacketFileBytes {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("private packet file refused: %s", pin.Name)
		}
		body, err := os.ReadFile(file)
		if err != nil || digest(body) != pin.SHA256 {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("private packet file drift: %s", pin.Name)
		}
		return body, nil
	}

	referencePin := filePin{Name: "reference.json", SHA256: expectedReferenceSHA256, Bytes: -1}
	// reference.json has a deterministic digest but a deliberately bounded, not
	// frozen, serialized length. Its own hash is still checked before decoding.
	if filepath.Base(referencePin.Name) != referencePin.Name {
		return fixtureConfig{}, errors.New("invalid reference pin")
	}
	refPath := filepath.Join(packet, referencePin.Name)
	refStat, err := os.Lstat(refPath)
	if err != nil || !refStat.Mode().IsRegular() || refStat.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 || refStat.Size() < 1 || refStat.Size() > 1<<20 {
		return fixtureConfig{}, errors.New("private reference file refused")
	}
	referenceBytes, err := os.ReadFile(refPath)
	if err != nil || digest(referenceBytes) != referencePin.SHA256 {
		return fixtureConfig{}, errors.New("private source reference drift")
	}
	var reference referencePacket
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(referenceBytes))
	if err := decoder.Decode(&reference); err != nil {
		return fixtureConfig{}, errors.New("private source reference malformed")
	}
	var extra any
	if err := decoder.Decode(&extra); err != io.EOF {
		return fixtureConfig{}, errors.New("private source reference malformed")
	}

	// Check every selected byte before creating a handler. HTML, screenshots and
	// licenses are intentionally not served, but their pins remain part of the
	// selected private closure and must not be allowed to drift unnoticed.
	if len(reference.Assets) < 3 || len(reference.Assets) > 128 || len(reference.Licenses) > 128 || len(reference.Frames) != 4 {
		return fixtureConfig{}, errors.New("private source closure exceeds bounds")
	}
	allPins := []filePin{reference.Plan, reference.Default, reference.Errors, reference.Countries, reference.Defaults, reference.Currencies}
	for _, asset := range reference.Assets {
		if !validAssetURL(asset.URL) || !allowedAssetMIME(asset.MIME) {
			return fixtureConfig{}, errors.New("private asset metadata refused")
		}
		allPins = append(allPins, asset.File)
	}
	allPins = append(allPins, reference.Licenses...)
	for _, frame := range reference.Frames {
		allPins = append(allPins, frame.Screenshot)
	}
	seen := make(map[string]bool, len(allPins))
	bodies := make(map[string][]byte, len(allPins))
	for _, pin := range allPins {
		if seen[pin.Name] {
			return fixtureConfig{}, errors.New("duplicate selected packet file")
		}
		seen[pin.Name] = true
		body, err := read(pin)
		if err != nil {
			return fixtureConfig{}, err
		}
		bodies[pin.Name] = body
	}

	var countries []converted.SettingsCountry
	var currencies []converted.SettingsCurrency
	var defaults map[string]json.RawMessage
	for _, target := range []struct {
		body []byte
		into any
	}{{bodies[reference.Countries.Name], &countries}, {bodies[reference.Currencies.Name], &currencies}, {bodies[reference.Defaults.Name], &defaults}} {
		if err := json.Unmarshal(target.body, target.into); err != nil {
			return fixtureConfig{}, errors.New("private option/default data malformed")
		}
	}
	initial, err := packetInitialValues(defaults)
	if err != nil {
		return fixtureConfig{}, err
	}
	policy, err := converted.NewSettingsPolicy(countries, currencies, initial)
	if err != nil {
		return fixtureConfig{}, fmt.Errorf("private settings policy: %w", err)
	}
	assets := make(map[string]fixtureAsset, len(reference.Assets))
	hasCSS, hasLocalFont := false, false
	for _, asset := range reference.Assets {
		if fixtureAssetRouteReserved(asset.URL) {
			return fixtureConfig{}, errors.New("private asset URL collides with fixture route")
		}
		if _, exists := assets[asset.URL]; exists {
			return fixtureConfig{}, errors.New("duplicate asset URL")
		}
		assets[asset.URL] = fixtureAsset{body: bodies[asset.File.Name], mime: asset.MIME}
		hasCSS = hasCSS || asset.MIME == "text/css"
		hasLocalFont = hasLocalFont || asset.MIME == "font/woff" || asset.MIME == "font/woff2"
	}
	if !hasCSS || !hasLocalFont {
		return fixtureConfig{}, errors.New("private source lacks local CSS/font closure")
	}
	cssURLs := make([]string, 0, len(assets))
	for assetURL, asset := range assets {
		if asset.mime == "text/css" {
			cssURLs = append(cssURLs, assetURL)
		}
	}
	sort.Strings(cssURLs)
	return fixtureConfig{policy: policy, initial: initial, assets: assets, cssURLs: cssURLs}, nil
}

func fixtureAssetRouteReserved(assetURL string) bool {
	switch assetURL {
	case "/fixture.css", "/native.css", "/controller.mjs", "/favicon.ico":
		return true
	}
	return false
}

func packetInitialValues(defaults map[string]json.RawMessage) (converted.SettingsValues, error) {
	values := url.Values{}
	for _, key := range nativeFieldKeys {
		raw, ok := defaults[key]
		if !ok {
			continue
		}
		var value string
		if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &value); err != nil {
			return converted.SettingsValues{}, fmt.Errorf("private default %q is not a string", key)
		}
		values.Set(key, value)
	}
	return converted.ParseSettingsValues(values)
}

func validPin(pin filePin) bool {
	if !validFlatName(pin.Name) || pin.Bytes < 0 || pin.Bytes > maxPacketFileBytes || len(pin.SHA256) != 64 {
		return false
	}
	_, err := hex.DecodeString(pin.SHA256)
	return err == nil
}

func validFlatName(value string) bool {
	if value == "" || filepath.Base(value) != value {
		return false
	}
	for _, c := range value {
		if !(c >= 'a' && c <= 'z' || c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z' || c >= '0' && c <= '9' || c == '.' || c == '_' || c == '-') {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func digest(body []byte) string { sum := sha256.Sum256(body); return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:]) }

func validAssetURL(value string) bool {
	if !strings.HasPrefix(value, "/") || strings.HasPrefix(value, "//") || strings.ContainsAny(value, "?#\\") || path.Clean(value) != value || value == "/" {
		return false
	}
	return true
}

func allowedAssetMIME(value string) bool {
	switch value {
	case "text/css", "font/woff", "font/woff2", "image/svg+xml":
		return true
	}
	return false
}

// cacheableStaticAssetURL is deliberately narrower than packet asset syntax.
// Packet identity binds the 43 selected bytes; this independent guard prevents a
// future fixture/test map from turning a document, route-data endpoint, or fixture
// control route into cacheable CSS by merely assigning it an allowed MIME.
func cacheableStaticAssetURL(value string) bool {
	if !validAssetURL(value) || fixtureAssetRouteReserved(value) || value == "/settings" || strings.HasPrefix(value, "/settings/") || strings.HasPrefix(value, "/api/") || strings.HasPrefix(value, "/_next/data/") {
		return false
	}
	if _, route := fixtureRoute(value); route {
		return false
	}
	return !strings.HasPrefix(value, "/_next/") || strings.HasPrefix(value, "/_next/static/")
}

func newFixtureHandler(config fixtureConfig) http.Handler {
	return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		if config.cache != nil {
			w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
		}
		if !boundLoopbackHost(config.host, r.Host) {
			http.Error(w, "misdirected fixture request", http.StatusMisdirectedRequest)
			return
		}
		// In cached-delivery mode every route starts as no-store. Only a clean,
		// selected static asset can override this after all routing guards.
		if r.URL.Path == "/favicon.ico" {
			if r.Method != http.MethodGet && r.Method != http.MethodHead {
				http.Error(w, "method not allowed", http.StatusMethodNotAllowed)
				return
			}
			// This form-only specimen has no application icon. Answer the browser's
			// automatic request explicitly, without a failed asset or borrowed brand.
			w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
			w.Header().Set("X-Content-Type-Options", "nosniff")
			w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent)
			return
		}
		if r.URL.Path == "/fixture.css" {
			if r.Method != http.MethodGet && r.Method != http.MethodHead {
				http.Error(w, "method not allowed", http.StatusMethodNotAllowed)
				return
			}
			w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/css")
			w.Header().Set("X-Content-Type-Options", "nosniff")
			w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
			if r.Method == http.MethodGet {
				_, _ = io.WriteString(w, fixtureCSS)
			}
			return
		}
		if r.URL.Path == "/native.css" {
			if r.Method != http.MethodGet && r.Method != http.MethodHead {
				http.Error(w, "method not allowed", http.StatusMethodNotAllowed)
				return
			}
			w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/css; charset=utf-8")
			w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
			w.Header().Set("X-Content-Type-Options", "nosniff")
			w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
			if r.Method == http.MethodGet {
				_, _ = io.WriteString(w, converted.SettingsNativeStyles())
			}
			return
		}
		if r.URL.Path == "/controller.mjs" {
			if r.Method != http.MethodGet && r.Method != http.MethodHead {
				http.Error(w, "method not allowed", http.StatusMethodNotAllowed)
				return
			}
			w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/javascript; charset=utf-8")
			w.Header().Set("X-Content-Type-Options", "nosniff")
			w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
			w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
			if r.Method == http.MethodGet {
				_, _ = w.Write(settingsController)
			}
			return
		}
		// v2 aliases are selected only by the wire RequestURI; a query is never
		// removed or interpreted for an incoming request. Host authority above is
		// intentionally checked before either asset map is consulted.
		if config.aliases != nil && cacheableFontAliasRequest(r) {
			if cached, ok := config.aliases.assets[r.RequestURI]; ok {
				setFontAliasDeliveryHeaders(w, config.aliases)
				serveCachedStaticAsset(w, r, cached)
				return
			}
		}
		if cached, ok := config.cache[r.URL.Path]; ok && cacheableStaticRequest(r) {
			if config.aliases != nil {
				setFontAliasDeliveryHeaders(w, config.aliases)
			}
			serveCachedStaticAsset(w, r, cached)
			return
		}
		if asset, ok := config.assets[r.URL.Path]; ok {
			if r.Method != http.MethodGet && r.Method != http.MethodHead {
				http.Error(w, "method not allowed", http.StatusMethodNotAllowed)
				return
			}
			w.Header().Set("Content-Type", asset.mime)
			w.Header().Set("X-Content-Type-Options", "nosniff")
			w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
			if r.Method == http.MethodGet {
				_, _ = w.Write(asset.body)
			}
			return
		}
		pathInfo, ok := fixtureRoute(r.URL.Path)
		if !ok {
			http.NotFound(w, r)
			return
		}
		if r.Method == http.MethodGet {
			serveForm(w, r, config, pathInfo, config.initial, false, "", "", http.StatusOK)
			return
		}
		if r.Method != http.MethodPost {
			w.Header().Set("Allow", "GET, POST")
			http.Error(w, "method not allowed", http.StatusMethodNotAllowed)
			return
		}
		handlePost(w, r, config, pathInfo)
	})
}

func setFontAliasDeliveryHeaders(w http.ResponseWriter, aliases *fontAliasDelivery) {
	w.Header().Set("X-AppKit-Font-Aliases-SHA256", aliases.manifestSHA256)
	w.Header().Set("X-AppKit-Delivery-Experiment", cachedStaticV2ID)
}

func cacheableStaticRequest(r *http.Request) bool {
	if r.Method != http.MethodGet && r.Method != http.MethodHead {
		return false
	}
	if r.URL.RawQuery != "" || r.URL.ForceQuery || r.URL.RawPath != "" || r.URL.EscapedPath() != r.URL.Path {
		return false
	}
	for _, header := range []string{"RSC", "Next-Router-Prefetch", "Next-Router-Segment-Prefetch", "Next-Router-State-Tree", "Next-Url", "Next-Action"} {
		if len(r.Header.Values(header)) != 0 {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func cacheableFontAliasRequest(r *http.Request) bool {
	if r.Method != http.MethodGet && r.Method != http.MethodHead {
		return false
	}
	for _, header := range []string{"RSC", "Next-Router-Prefetch", "Next-Router-Segment-Prefetch", "Next-Router-State-Tree", "Next-Url", "Next-Action"} {
		if len(r.Header.Values(header)) != 0 {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func serveCachedStaticAsset(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, asset cachedFixtureAsset) {
	gzipSelected, acceptable := selectStaticEncoding(r.Header.Get("Accept-Encoding"))
	w.Header().Set("Vary", "Accept-Encoding")
	if !acceptable {
		w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
		http.Error(w, "no acceptable static representation", http.StatusNotAcceptable)
		return
	}
	body, etag := asset.body, asset.identityETag
	if gzipSelected {
		body, etag = asset.gzipBody, asset.gzipETag
		w.Header().Set("Content-Encoding", "gzip")
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", asset.mime)
	w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "private, max-age=60")
	w.Header().Set("ETag", etag)
	w.Header().Set("Content-Length", strconv.Itoa(len(body)))
	w.Header().Set("X-Appkit-Decoded-SHA256", asset.decodedSHA256)
	w.Header().Set("X-Content-Type-Options", "nosniff")
	if ifNoneMatch(r.Header.Values("If-None-Match"), etag) {
		w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNotModified)
		return
	}
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
	if r.Method == http.MethodGet {
		_, _ = w.Write(body)
	}
}

// selectStaticEncoding is intentionally narrow: unknown encodings are ignored,
// identity is the default when no header is present, and gzip wins only a q tie.
func selectStaticEncoding(acceptEncoding string) (gzipSelected, acceptable bool) {
	if strings.TrimSpace(acceptEncoding) == "" {
		return false, true
	}
	identityQ, gzipQ, starQ := 1.0, 0.0, -1.0
	identitySet, gzipSet := false, false
	for _, item := range strings.Split(acceptEncoding, ",") {
		name, q, valid := staticCodingItem(item)
		switch name {
		case "gzip":
			if gzipSet || !valid {
				gzipQ = 0
			} else {
				gzipQ = q
			}
			gzipSet = true
		case "identity":
			if identitySet || !valid {
				identityQ = 0
			} else {
				identityQ = q
			}
			identitySet = true
		case "*":
			if !valid {
				starQ = 0
			} else {
				starQ = q
			}
		}
	}
	if !identitySet && starQ == 0 {
		identityQ = 0
	}
	if !gzipSet && starQ >= 0 {
		gzipQ = starQ
	}
	if gzipQ <= 0 && identityQ <= 0 {
		return false, false
	}
	return gzipQ > 0 && gzipQ >= identityQ, true
}

// staticCodingItem accepts exactly one coding token with an optional single
// `; OWS q=<RFC qvalue>` parameter. Unknown/extra parameters, duplicate q values,
// whitespace around `=`, and trailing data invalidate the named coding rather than
// upgrading it through a partial parse.
func staticCodingItem(item string) (name string, q float64, valid bool) {
	item = strings.TrimSpace(item)
	if item == "" {
		return "", 0, false
	}
	semicolon := strings.IndexByte(item, ';')
	if semicolon < 0 {
		return strings.ToLower(item), 1, true
	}
	name = strings.ToLower(item[:semicolon])
	parameter := strings.TrimLeft(item[semicolon+1:], " \t")
	if name == "" || len(parameter) < 3 || !strings.EqualFold(parameter[:1], "q") || parameter[1] != '=' {
		return name, 0, false
	}
	q, valid = staticEncodingQ(parameter[2:])
	return name, q, valid
}

// staticEncodingQ accepts only RFC 9110's complete qvalue grammar. In particular,
// it rejects partial scans, NaN, and a fourth fractional digit rather than silently
// treating an invalid preference as a cacheable gzip preference.
func staticEncodingQ(value string) (float64, bool) {
	if value == "0" || value == "1" {
		return float64(value[0] - '0'), true
	}
	if len(value) < 2 || len(value) > 5 || value[1] != '.' || value[0] != '0' && value[0] != '1' {
		return 0, false
	}
	fraction := 0.0
	place := 0.1
	for _, digit := range value[2:] {
		if digit < '0' || digit > '9' || value[0] == '1' && digit != '0' {
			return 0, false
		}
		fraction += float64(digit-'0') * place
		place /= 10
	}
	return float64(value[0]-'0') + fraction, true
}

func ifNoneMatch(values []string, etag string) bool {
	for _, value := range values {
		for _, candidate := range strings.Split(value, ",") {
			candidate = strings.TrimSpace(candidate)
			if candidate == "*" {
				return true
			}
			candidate = strings.TrimSpace(strings.TrimPrefix(candidate, "W/"))
			if candidate == etag {
				return true
			}
		}
	}
	return false
}

type routeInfo struct {
	theme, action, reset string
	enhance              bool
}

func fixtureRoute(requestPath string) (routeInfo, bool) {
	switch requestPath {
	case "/light/settings":
		return routeInfo{theme: "light", action: "/light/settings", reset: "/light/settings/reset"}, true
	case "/light/settings/reset":
		return routeInfo{theme: "light", action: "/light/settings", reset: "/light/settings/reset"}, true
	case "/dark/settings":
		return routeInfo{theme: "dark", action: "/dark/settings", reset: "/dark/settings/reset"}, true
	case "/dark/settings/reset":
		return routeInfo{theme: "dark", action: "/dark/settings", reset: "/dark/settings/reset"}, true
	case "/light/enhanced/settings", "/light/enhanced/settings/reset":
		return routeInfo{theme: "light", action: "/light/enhanced/settings", reset: "/light/enhanced/settings/reset", enhance: true}, true
	case "/dark/enhanced/settings", "/dark/enhanced/settings/reset":
		return routeInfo{theme: "dark", action: "/dark/enhanced/settings", reset: "/dark/enhanced/settings/reset", enhance: true}, true
	default:
		return routeInfo{}, false
	}
}

func handlePost(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, config fixtureConfig, route routeInfo) {
	if r.URL.RawQuery != "" || !sameOriginRequest(r, config.host) || strings.EqualFold(strings.TrimSpace(r.Header.Get("Sec-Fetch-Site")), "cross-site") {
		http.Error(w, "invalid request framing", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	mediaType, _, err := mime.ParseMediaType(r.Header.Get("Content-Type"))
	if r.ContentLength > maxPOSTBytes {
		http.Error(w, "request too large", http.StatusRequestEntityTooLarge)
		return
	}
	if err != nil || mediaType != "application/x-www-form-urlencoded" {
		http.Error(w, "invalid request framing", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	body, err := io.ReadAll(http.MaxBytesReader(w, r.Body, maxPOSTBytes))
	if err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, http.ErrBodyReadAfterClose) {
			http.Error(w, "invalid request framing", http.StatusBadRequest)
		} else {
			http.Error(w, "request too large", http.StatusRequestEntityTooLarge)
		}
		return
	}
	form, err := url.ParseQuery(string(body))
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "invalid request framing", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	csrf, action, err := extractControls(form)
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "invalid request framing", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	if action == "reset" && r.URL.Path != route.reset || action == "validate" && r.URL.Path != route.action {
		http.Error(w, "invalid request framing", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	cookie, err := r.Cookie(csrfCookieName)
	if err != nil || !validCSRFToken(cookie.Value) || !validCSRFToken(csrf) || subtle.ConstantTimeCompare([]byte(cookie.Value), []byte(csrf)) != 1 {
		http.Error(w, "invalid request framing", http.StatusForbidden)
		return
	}
	values, err := converted.ParseSettingsValues(form)
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "invalid request framing", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	if action == "reset" {
		serveForm(w, r, config, route, config.initial, false, "", "reset", http.StatusOK)
		return
	}
	validation, err := config.policy.Validate(values)
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "fixture policy unavailable", http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	if validation.FirstError != "" {
		serveForm(w, r, config, route, values, true, "", validation.FirstError, http.StatusUnprocessableEntity)
		return
	}
	if config.refuse != nil && config.refuse(r) {
		serveForm(w, r, config, route, values, false, "Synthetic backend unavailable: draft retained; nothing was saved. Try Validate changes again.", "status", http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
		return
	}
	serveForm(w, r, config, route, values, false, "validated; nothing was saved", "", http.StatusOK)
}

func extractControls(form url.Values) (csrf, action string, err error) {
	for _, key := range []string{"_csrf", "_action"} {
		items := form[key]
		if len(items) != 1 || items[0] == "" {
			return "", "", errors.New("missing or duplicate control")
		}
		delete(form, key)
		if key == "_csrf" {
			csrf = items[0]
		} else {
			action = items[0]
		}
	}
	if action != "validate" && action != "reset" {
		return "", "", errors.New("unknown action")
	}
	return csrf, action, nil
}

func serveForm(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, config fixtureConfig, route routeInfo, values converted.SettingsValues, showErrors bool, status, focus string, responseStatus int) {
	token, issueCookie, err := csrfToken(r)
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "could not establish synthetic session", http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	component, err := converted.NewSettingsForm(config.policy, values, converted.SettingsPresentation{
		ID: "p10-settings", Action: route.action, ResetAction: route.reset, CSRFToken: token,
		ShowErrors: showErrors, Status: status, Focus: focus, ErrorClass: sourceErrorClass, Enhance: route.enhance,
	})
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "could not prepare synthetic form", http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	var rendered bytes.Buffer
	if err := component.Render(r.Context(), &rendered); err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "could not render synthetic form", http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	page := fixturePage(route, config.cssURLs, rendered.String())
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/html; charset=utf-8")
	scripts := "'none'"
	if route.enhance {
		scripts = "'self'"
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Security-Policy", "default-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; font-src 'self'; script-src "+scripts+"; form-action 'self'; base-uri 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'")
	w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
	w.Header().Set("Pragma", "no-cache")
	w.Header().Set("X-Content-Type-Options", "nosniff")
	w.Header().Set("Referrer-Policy", "same-origin")
	if issueCookie {
		http.SetCookie(w, &http.Cookie{Name: csrfCookieName, Value: token, Path: "/", HttpOnly: true, SameSite: http.SameSiteStrictMode})
	}
	w.WriteHeader(responseStatus)
	_, _ = io.WriteString(w, page)
}

func csrfToken(r *http.Request) (string, bool, error) {
	if cookie, err := r.Cookie(csrfCookieName); err == nil && validCSRFToken(cookie.Value) {
		return cookie.Value, false, nil
	}
	bytes := make([]byte, 32)
	if _, err := rand.Read(bytes); err != nil {
		return "", false, err
	}
	return base64.RawURLEncoding.EncodeToString(bytes), true, nil
}

func validCSRFToken(value string) bool {
	if len(value) != base64.RawURLEncoding.EncodedLen(32) {
		return false
	}
	decoded, err := base64.RawURLEncoding.DecodeString(value)
	return err == nil && len(decoded) == 32
}

func fixturePage(route routeInfo, cssURLs []string, form string) string {
	links := make([]string, 0, len(cssURLs)+2)
	for _, assetURL := range cssURLs {
		links = append(links, `<link rel="stylesheet" href="`+assetURL+`">`)
	}
	// This private companion comes after the selected source stylesheet and changes
	// only native control focus/minimum-size behavior inside the adapted form.
	links = append(links, `<link rel="stylesheet" href="/native.css">`)
	// The fixture keeps only its frame/theme/font boundary; it supplies no source
	// palette, classes, or form-control geometry.
	links = append(links, `<link rel="stylesheet" href="/fixture.css">`)
	bodyAttrs, module := "", ""
	if route.enhance {
		bodyAttrs = " data-p10-enhance"
		module = `<script type="module" src="/controller.mjs"></script>`
	}
	return "<!doctype html><html lang=\"en\" class=\"p10-fixture-theme " + route.theme + "\"><head><meta charset=\"utf-8\"><meta name=\"viewport\" content=\"width=device-width, initial-scale=1\">" + strings.Join(links, "") + "</head><body" + bodyAttrs + "><main class=\"p10-fixture-frame\">" + form + "</main>" + module + "</body></html>"
}

const fixtureCSS = `html{color-scheme:light}html.p10-fixture-theme.dark{color-scheme:dark}body{margin:0;font-family:Inter,sans-serif}.p10-fixture-frame{box-sizing:border-box;width:calc(100% - 48px);max-width:896px;margin:24px auto}@media (min-width:640px){.p10-fixture-frame{width:calc(100% - 64px);margin:32px auto}}`

func boundLoopbackHost(expected, actual string) bool {
	if expected == "" || actual != expected {
		return false
	}
	host, port, err := net.SplitHostPort(expected)
	if err != nil || port == "" {
		return false
	}
	ip := net.ParseIP(host)
	return ip != nil && ip.IsLoopback()
}

func sameOriginRequest(r *http.Request, host string) bool {
	seen := false
	for _, header := range []string{"Origin", "Referer"} {
		values := r.Header.Values(header)
		if len(values) == 0 {
			continue
		}
		if len(values) != 1 || strings.TrimSpace(values[0]) == "" {
			return false
		}
		value := values[0]
		u, err := url.Parse(value)
		if err != nil || u.Scheme != "http" || u.Host != host || u.User != nil || u.Fragment != "" {
			return false
		}
		if header == "Origin" && (u.Path != "" || u.RawQuery != "") {
			return false
		}
		seen = true
	}
	return seen // Referrer-Policy may omit Referer, but protected POST needs an origin signal.
}

// Refusal is an explicit synthetic process mode, not a query/header or form value
// that alters application policy. It is reached only after protected validation.
func parseFixtureArgs(args []string) (packet string, refuseFirst bool, err error) {
	if len(args) < 1 || len(args) > 2 || len(args) == 2 && args[1] != "--refuse-first-validation" {
		return "", false, errors.New("usage: catalyst-settings-fixture ABSOLUTE_PRIVATE_PACKET [--refuse-first-validation]")
	}
	return args[0], len(args) == 2, nil
}

// parseFixtureDeliveryArgs extends launch selection without changing the legacy
// parseFixtureArgs contract. The two synthetic modes deliberately cannot mix.
func parseFixtureDeliveryArgs(args []string) (packet string, refuseFirst, cachedStatic bool, err error) {
	packet, refuseFirst, err = parseFixtureArgs(args)
	if err == nil {
		return packet, refuseFirst, false, nil
	}
	if len(args) == 2 && args[1] == "--cached-static-delivery="+cachedStaticV1ID {
		return args[0], false, true, nil
	}
	return "", false, false, errors.New("usage: catalyst-settings-fixture ABSOLUTE_PRIVATE_PACKET [--refuse-first-validation|--cached-static-delivery=p10-cached-static-v1]")
}

// parseFixtureDeliveryV2Args adds one separately selected launch mode. Keeping
// the v1 wrapper unchanged protects callers/tests that intentionally exercise its
// narrower contract and makes mixed experimental flags a refusal.
func parseFixtureDeliveryV2Args(args []string) (packet string, refuseFirst, cachedV1, cachedV2 bool, err error) {
	packet, refuseFirst, cachedV1, err = parseFixtureDeliveryArgs(args)
	if err == nil {
		return packet, refuseFirst, cachedV1, false, nil
	}
	if len(args) == 2 && args[1] == "--cached-static-delivery="+cachedStaticV2ID {
		return args[0], false, false, true, nil
	}
	return "", false, false, false, errors.New("usage: catalyst-settings-fixture ABSOLUTE_PRIVATE_PACKET [--refuse-first-validation|--cached-static-delivery=p10-cached-static-v1|--cached-static-delivery=p10-cached-static-v2]")
}

func firstValidationRefusal() func(*http.Request) bool {
	var used atomic.Bool
	return func(*http.Request) bool { return used.CompareAndSwap(false, true) }
}

type fixtureStartup struct {
	URL                   string `json:"url"`
	PID                   int    `json:"pid"`
	RefuseFirstValidation bool   `json:"refuse_first_validation,omitempty"`
	StaticDelivery        string `json:"static_delivery,omitempty"`
	AliasManifestSHA256   string `json:"alias_manifest_sha256,omitempty"`
}

func fixtureStartupJSON(host string, pid int, refuseFirst, cachedStatic bool) []byte {
	staticDelivery := ""
	if cachedStatic {
		staticDelivery = cachedStaticV1ID
	}
	return fixtureStartupDeliveryJSON(host, pid, refuseFirst, staticDelivery, "")

}

func fixtureStartupDeliveryJSON(host string, pid int, refuseFirst bool, staticDelivery, aliasManifestSHA256 string) []byte {
	encoded, _ := json.Marshal(fixtureStartup{URL: "http://" + host, PID: pid, RefuseFirstValidation: refuseFirst, StaticDelivery: staticDelivery, AliasManifestSHA256: aliasManifestSHA256})
	return encoded
}

func main() {
	packet, refuseFirst, cachedV1, cachedV2, err := parseFixtureDeliveryV2Args(os.Args[1:])
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
		os.Exit(2)
	}
	config, err := loadFixturePacket(packet)
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "private fixture refused:", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	if refuseFirst {
		config.refuse = firstValidationRefusal()
	}
	if cachedV1 || cachedV2 {
		config.cache, err = prepareCachedStaticAssets(config.assets)
		if err != nil {
			fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "private fixture cached-static setup:", err)
			os.Exit(1)
		}
	}
	if cachedV2 {
		config.aliases, err = prepareP10FontQueryAliases(config.assets, config.cache)
		if err != nil {
			fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "private fixture cached-static v2 setup:", err)
			os.Exit(1)
		}
	}
	listener, err := net.Listen("tcp", "127.0.0.1:0")
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "fixture listener:", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	config.host = listener.Addr().String()
	server := &http.Server{Handler: newFixtureHandler(config), ReadHeaderTimeout: 5 * time.Second}
	delivery, manifestSHA256 := "", ""
	if cachedV1 {
		delivery = cachedStaticV1ID
	}
	if cachedV2 {
		delivery, manifestSHA256 = cachedStaticV2ID, config.aliases.manifestSHA256
	}
	fmt.Println(string(fixtureStartupDeliveryJSON(config.host, os.Getpid(), refuseFirst, delivery, manifestSHA256)))
	stop := make(chan os.Signal, 1)
	signal.Notify(stop, syscall.SIGINT, syscall.SIGTERM)
	go func() { _ = server.Serve(listener) }()
	<-stop
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	_ = server.Shutdown(ctx)
}
